questions.question: Where did South Africa Women play their first-ever T20I, in August 2007?
questions.explanation: South Africa's first women's T20I was against New Zealand at the County Ground, Taunton, on 10 August 2007, a neutral venue in England.

questions.question: Who has achieved the century and 4 wickets in a match double more times, Suné Luus or Mieke van Voorst?
